thread:
sara_sales: Hey team — acme demo in 30m and customer is seeing intermittent 503s on the POC. Getting lots of failures across multiple endpoints. Can someone triage? /cc @lee_se @mohit_support
lee_se: On it. Can you paste a few request_ids and sample payloads? Are they all the same model/route?
sara_sales: request ids: req_8a3f, req_8a4e, req_8b00. Using hosted API route "redwood.generate" model: rw-open-1-large, seq_len ~1024. No code changes since yesterday.
mohit_support: Thx. I'm seeing a 503 spike at 14:11 UTC in our telemetry. Likely backlog + autoscaler lag. Can you set retries with exponential backoff (retry-after 1s, 2s, 4s) for the demo? Quick patch: add header "x-rw-priority: high" to route to demo tier while we investigate.
elena_sre: Alerts show autoscaler scaled from 0->3 nodes but pods weren't ready for ~70s due to image pull. Looks like the nodePool in region-us-east-1 hit an image-pull rate limit. I'm re-running a scale with warm nodes.
alerts-bot: [autoscaler] scale_up requested at 14:11:31 UTC -> target=3, current=0, status=delayed (image_pull_rate_limit)
lee_se: If image pull is the blocker we can immediate failover to "rw-open-1-medium" which is already warm in other pools. Sara, can you accept <10% perf drop?
sara_sales: Yes customer ok with slight perf hit as long as demo runs. Do it.
mohit_support: Executed routing override to fallback model for acme-demo API key. Please try again, and paste any new request ids.
sara_sales: Trying now... got 200s but some responses truncated. Also seeing 429s now for embeddings route.
elena_sre: 429s likely from a burst quota on the edge gateway. Pushed a temporary increase to the demo API key (rate quota +1000 qps) for 10 minutes. Monitor for abuse.
lee_se: For truncated responses, suggest reducing max_tokens from 800 -> 512 and enabling streaming. Also add header "x-rw-no-cache: true" to avoid KV cache edge cases during model switch.
sara_sales: OK adjusted max_tokens and turned on streaming. Demo flow is stable so far. Customer starting the scenario...
alerts-bot: [infra] nodepool us-east-warm now ready (3 nodes). Image pulls completed.
elena_sre: Reverted fallback routing back to primary model and left warm nodes in pool. We'll keep the quota increase for 5 more mins.
mohit_support: Root cause summary: sudden load spike from demo scripts caused request backlog. Autoscaler attempted to scale but was delayed by image-pull rate limits on cold nodes -> temporary 503s during ramp. Mitigations applied: model failover, temporary quota bump, reduced token budget, enabled streaming. Longer-term actions: pre-warm nodepools for paid POCs, improve image distribution, add faster scale-up for reserved-demo keys.
sara_sales: Thanks team! Can we get an internal ticket and an owner for pre-warm? Sales wants this added to the POC checklist.
lee_se: Created ticket RW-POC-4321 and assigned to infra (elena). Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/RW-POC-4321
sara_sales: Added customer note and closing thread. :tada:
